name: Albescent-Shoal
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, a binary sunset emerge like the bones of the planet.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
